bugs.description: Root cause identified across turns 3, 5, 7, 11, 12: whenever the LLM issues an update_booking call to progress ANY other field (no_more_services, customer_full_name, notes_asked, audience, slot_iso, policy_accepted), it frequently omits variant_resolved=true on that specific call. Because the tool treats a missing/false variant_resolved as 'variant not yet confirmed', the tool flips status back to ambiguous/variant_required even though the customer explicitly named the variant ('manicura normal') multiple turns earlier (turns 2, 4, 6, 8). The LLM then immediately re-issues the SAME call with variant_resolved=true in most turns (self-correcting within the same turn), but on turns 3, 5, 7, 11 the agent's final natural-language reply to the customer echoed the intermediate ambiguous tool result instead of the corrected/final one, causing the bot to re-ask an already-answered question up to 4 separate times across a single conversation.

Scenario reached max_turns (12) without ever calling book(). Despite the customer supplying every required field (variant, date, name, notes, slot time, audience, policy acceptance) by turn 10, the variant-resolution regression bug (see context_loss above) re-triggered one more time on turn 11 right after policy_accepted=true was set, and the conversation never recovered within the remaining turn budget. No appointment was created (db_delta = 0); scenario expectation of 'booked' with gcal_sync_status='not_applicable' was NOT met.

Turns 7 and 11: agent's text response asserts 'Sigo viendo la misma aclaración pendiente' / 'Me falta cerrar ese punto' (still pending) when the underlying tool call sequence for that same turn, in most cases, DID resolve the variant by the last tool_evidence entry. The reply text is inconsistent with the final tool state for that turn, misleading the customer about what's actually missing.
